comment.zh-TW: 主因是濃霧／低雲。目前沒有機場預報與機場觀測可對照，只有美國模式提供能見度：10/28 14–20 時與 20 時–10/29 02 時低到 76 公尺，10/29 08–20 時 83 公尺，10/30 午後 152 公尺，多個白天與傍晚時段反覆偏低。其他模式陣風都在 19 節以下，雨量最多 7.6 毫米，陣風超過 49 節的機率 0%。單一模式撐起訊號但數字極低，評為中。

comment.zh-CN: 主因是浓雾／低云。目前没有机场预报与机场观测可对照，只有美国模式提供能见度：10/28 14–20 时与 20 时至 10/29 02 时低至 76 米，10/29 08–20 时 83 米，10/30 午后 152 米，多个白天与傍晚时段反复偏低。其他模式阵风都在 19 节以下，雨量最多 7.6 毫米，阵风超过 49 节的概率 0%。单一模式支撑信号但数字极低，评为中。
comment.en: The main cause is fog/low cloud. There is no airport forecast (TAF) or airport observation (METAR) to check against; only the US model gives visibility: as low as 76 m on 10/28 14-20 h and 20 h to 10/29 02 h local, 83 m on 10/29 08-20 h, and 152 m on the afternoon of 10/30, repeatedly low across several daytime and evening periods. Gusts in the other models stay below 19 kt, rain peaks at 7.6 mm, and the chance of gusts over 49 kt is 0%. A single model carries the signal, but its numbers are very low, so we rate it Medium.

comment.en: Over the next 5 days the main factor is fog/low cloud, but the evidence is thin: for 10/28 14:00 to 10/29 02:00 only the US model shows visibility 337 m, and it reaches Medium because it is the only model with visibility data. The airport forecast (TAF) gives visibility 9999 m, and the airport observation (METAR) shows a mean wind of 7 kt and cloud base 3200 ft; the highest gust among the models is the Japanese model's estimated gust of 28.4 kt, with a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt. A strong wind advisory is in effect, but the data show no strong wind, so the overall disruption risk is rated Low.

comment.zh-TW: 未來五天主因天氣為濃霧／低雲，但整體停飛風險評估為低。雖然美國模式在 10/28 14 時至 10/29 02 時預報能見度 337 公尺而使該時段列為中，但其在 10/27 14 時至 10/28 02 時也預報能見度 181 公尺，同期的機場觀測（METAR）與機場預報（TAF）能見度卻高達 9999 公尺，顯示單一模式明顯低估能見度。此外全期陣風超過 29 節的機率 0%，6 小時雨量至多 2.9 毫米，無明顯強風或大雨威脅。

comment.zh-CN: 未来五天主因天气为浓雾／低云，但整体停飞风险评估为低。虽然美国模式在 10/28 14 时至 10/29 02 时预报能见度 337 米而使该时段列为中，但其在 10/27 14 时至 10/28 02 时也预报能见度 181 米，同期的机场观测（METAR）与机场预报（TAF）能见度却高达 9999 米，显示单一模式明显低估能见度。此外全期阵风超过 29 节的概率 0%，6 小时雨量至多 2.9 毫米，无明显强风或大雨威胁。
comment.en: The main weather factor over the next five days is fog/low cloud, but the overall disruption risk is assessed as Low. Although the US model forecasts visibility of 337 m from 10/28 14:00 to 10/29 02:00 local, placing those periods at Medium, it also forecasts visibility of 181 m from 10/27 14:00 to 10/28 02:00 local while the airport observation (METAR) and airport forecast (TAF) for the same period show visibility of 9999 m, indicating this single model significantly underestimates visibility. Furthermore, there is a 0% chance of gusts over 29 kt throughout and at most 2.9 mm of rain in 6 hours, posing no significant strong wind or heavy rain threat.
